assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: All geometry uses provisional boundaries (PROV-*) from the site package; official polygons are not yet available.
assumptions.impact: After official boundary release, all layer areas, metrics, figures and drawings must be recomputed.

assumptions.statement: Rail/transit interchange concepts (Line 13 stations, Qinghuayuan station) are conceptual connectors, not official alignments.
assumptions.impact: Confirm with rail authority before any statutory use.

assumptions.statement: The provisional Dazhongsi polygon centroid reportedly deviates from the public Dazhongsi station location by ~2.26 km (upstream Issue #1029).
assumptions.impact: Dazhongsi-area conclusions are directional only until official geometry is provided.

assumptions.statement: Contributors and the AI agent have not conducted on-site surveys; user needs are assumptions from public data, not field-verified conclusions (per issue #1061 / site_and_stakeholder_evidence).
assumptions.impact: This proposal must not be read as field-verified or resident-approved; formal public participation is the organizer's responsibility.
